_comment: Data identifiers (DIDs) readable from F10 ECUs.
This file is intentionally EMPTY. No DID for this vehicle has been
verified yet. Do not populate it from memory, from forum posts, or from
another platform's definitions without recording the source and testing
the DID against the actual car.
Only read-only identifiers belong here. Anything writable must not be
added until a write safety gate exists and has been reviewed.

_schema.identifier: DID as a hex string, e.g. "F190" (required)
_schema.name: machine-readable name (required)
_schema.length: expected response payload length in bytes (required)
_schema.source: where this definition came from; required for verified entries
_schema.verified: true only when confirmed against the vehicle
_schema.ecu: ECU the identifier applies to, e.g. DME
_schema.access: must be "read" for every entry in the read-only phase
